claims.claim: Anthropic officially launched Claude Sonnet 5.5, engineered as a high-speed frontier workhorse with a 1-million-token context window and 128,000-token max output limit.
claims.notes: Official release across Anthropic API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI, and Microsoft Azure.

claims.claim: Claude Sonnet 5.5 achieved a record 70.6% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 for agentic coding and 80.1% on OSWorld 2.1 for autonomous computer use.
claims.notes: Significant generational leap over previous Sonnet models in autonomous execution.

claims.claim: The model generates output over 30% faster than Sonnet 5 while preserving pricing at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens.
claims.notes: Provides top-tier agentic capability at accessible mid-tier API cost.

editorial_cautions: Differentiate Sonnet 5.5 (high-speed daily driver agent) from flagship Opus 5.5 (complex multi-agent orchestration).
Highlight the 70.6% Terminal-Bench 4.0 score and 128k output limit.
